==The Cat Tree==
[[File:3408.png|thumb|400px]]Hex 34.05

Connects to: 17.07.04, 26.01, 30.03 and the Lands of the Night Cattle.

There can be found [[cat trees|a tree]] that is home to [[winged cats|a flock of cats]] and they can be seen flying clumsily throughout much of the surrounding forest.
